venue_id = #{venueId},
start_time = #{startTime},
sell_time = #{sellTime},
status = #{status},

mapper.select: select v.venue_name,es.start_time,e.event_name from event_sessions es left join venues v on es.venue_id = v.venue_id left join events e on es.event_id = e.event_id where es.event_session_id = #{eventSessionId}

SELECT es.sell_time,es.status,tt.ticket_permit FROM event_sessions es join ticket_tiers tt on es.event_session_id = tt.event_session_id where tt.event_session_id = #{eventSessionId} and tt.ticket_level = #{ticketLevel}
SELECT event_session_id FROM event_sessions WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT event_id FROM event_sessions WHERE status = 0
